# [TASK] Replace inline qualified class names with static imports in tests

## Task
Test classes across the backend had inline fully-qualified or class-qualified
calls (`org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows(...)`,
`Assertions.assertEquals(...)`) instead of static imports, adding
noise at every call site. Sweep the backend test tree, convert every
qualified JUnit/AssertJ/Mockito/Hamcrest/MockMvc call site to a static
import, and codify the convention as mandatory in the Cursor rules so it
doesn't drift back.

## No parent
<!-- Standalone technical work with no user-facing slice; related to the
     ongoing housekeeping under Epic #76. -->

## Scope
Backend test sources only (`backend/**/src/test/**/*.java`). Main-source
qualified calls (if any) and frontend code are out of scope.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Given the backend test tree, when grepped for fully-qualified or
      class-qualified calls to `Assertions`, `Mockito`, `ArgumentMatchers`,
      `BDDMockito`, `Matchers`/`CoreMatchers`, or
      `MockMvcRequestBuilders`/`MockMvcResultMatchers`/`MockMvcResultHandlers`,
      then none remain outside import statements.
- [x] Given a fixed test file, when `spotlessApply` and `compileTestJava` run
      for its module, then both succeed with no unused-import or
      compile errors.
- [x] Given `.cursor/rules/spring-boot-development.mdc`, when a developer or
      AI assistant reads the testing section, then it states static imports
      are mandatory in test code, with a bad/good example.
- [x] Given the touched modules' fast (non-Testcontainers) test suites, when
      run, then they pass unchanged.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 1

## Notes
Found only 6 files with real violations after excluding import-line false
positives: `MovieControllerErrorTest`, `PrometheusEndpointTest`,
`AiServiceIntegrationTest` (movie-service/ai-service), and
`MediaControllerTest`/`MediaFileTest`/`MediaServiceTest` (media-service).
`movie-service` and `media-service` fast suites verified green
(19 tests). `PrometheusEndpointTest`/`AiServiceIntegrationTest` need
Testcontainers (Mongo/Postgres); the Mongo container failed to start in
this sandbox (pre-existing Docker networking limitation, unrelated to this
change — confirmed via `compileTestJava` passing and the failure trace
showing only a container port timeout, no code/import errors).
